preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi + 1 <= i for i in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: Each parent index pi + 1 must be valid and less than or equal to the current vertex index i.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv' for c in [c for _, c in edges])
preconditions.description: Each character on the edges must be a lowercase English letter between 'a' and 'v'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each integer in the output must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == longest_path_length(i + 1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th integer in the output must represent the length of the longest simple path in the subtree of the i-th vertex that forms a Dokhtar-kosh string.
